verdict.rationale: Galileo's official MCP server lets AI-powered IDEs and agents create and manage datasets and run experiments directly, and experiments evaluate prompts, models, and app code against chosen metrics. This covers the agent-driven dataset creation and programmatic eval-run core of the story. missing for 10: explicit evidence that an agent can read back experiment results/metric scores via MCP or SDK, a public OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end agent workflow.
